problem: The training history UI requested thirty recent audit events by user and recorded_at but lacked a matching ordering index, forcing a scan of that user's historical events and a temporary sort
scope: Only one additive schema index and four new regression cases; the UI query text and scientific as-of ordering were not changed
query: SELECT * FROM training_event WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 30

index.name: training_event_recent
index.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS training_event_recent ON training_event(user_id,recorded_at DESC)
index.kind: ordinary, not partial: the query includes all audit statuses and entity types
index.migration: Idempotent STATEMENTS entry inside the existing training migration savepoint; no new marker or event rewrite

fixture.creation: Real TrainingService.create_equipment mutations on an isolated synthetic Repository
fixture.timestamps: Unique alternating one-second timestamps across users; a separate case explicitly creates forty tied local-user timestamps and later timestamps for the other user

failing_before.interpretation: Two passes preserve ordinary query results and the existing tie contract. Two failures prove the unbounded query plan and absent index migration. The isolated schema bytes matched the active pre-fix schema.

passing_after.interpretation: All four directed cases passed on the frozen active source; source and test hashes were unchanged during execution

sqlite_work_evidence.method: sqlite3.set_progress_handler callback every one virtual-machine instruction while executing and fetching the exact UI query; no hard elapsed-time threshold
before_query_plan: USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
sqlite_work_evidence.precision_note: The passing run records the tested upper bound, not an invented exact instruction count or extrapolated million-event latency.

result_and_preservation_contract.distinct_timestamps: For each user, the thirty complete returned rows equal a full synthetic reference ordering; original event bytes remain unchanged
result_and_preservation_contract.ties: The original SQL declares no secondary key. Forty same-time local events yield thirty distinct local events from that tied set with the declared timestamp order; no fixed UUID subset or tied ordering is claimed
result_and_preservation_contract.migration: Interrupted index creation rolls back; successful upgrade and rerun retain all original training_event row values
result_and_preservation_contract.raw_timestamp_text: Preserved; this index retains the UI's existing SQLite text ordering, without changing the separate exact-UTC as-of contract

sanitization: Private repository/home/pytest temporary paths and runtime memory addresses replaced
Hostname, host and pid attributes removed
Environment properties and captured stdout/stderr removed from public XML
Test identities, actual counts, assertions and timings retained
Unmodified raw XML, logs and source receipts retained locally with SHA256
limits: Four directed tests do not replace the coordinator's fresh final repository-wide run
Formal stage 3 scale/UI measurements are separate; no claim that the two-second million-event UI budget is already met
Earlier stage 2 performance and test evidence remain unchanged
